components.name: api
components.start: server=apps/api/src/server.ts; if [ ! -f "$server" ]; then server=$(find . -path '*/apps/api/src/server.ts' -print -quit); fi; exec node "$server"

env.name: PORT
env.description: The one port the app listens on. The platform sets it to `port`.

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.description: The address people open the app at, for absolute links.

env.name: MONGODB_URI
env.description: The app's MongoDB database; its path is the database name.

env.name: MAITENTO_BASE_URL
env.description: The Maitento API. Defaults to https://api.maitento.com.

env.name: MAITENTO_API_KEY
env.description: The app's Maitento key. Without it the app runs and AI features answer "AI not connected".

env.name: MAITENTO_NAMESPACE
env.description: The namespace the maitento/ project is deployed to and runs in.

env.name: SIMULATED_DATA_SCENARIO
env.description: Selects the simulated source-data scenario for analyst replays: clean, disputed_invoice, low_bureau or returned_cheques.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: The least important log lines the app writes: debug, info, warn or error.
